# RetroOS 98

RetroOS 98 rebuilds a Windows 95/98 interface in Obsidian, covering UI elements, scrollbars, checkboxes and file-explorer styling. Several period colour schemes are included, among them Windows Plus number 4, together with a light and dark switch, adjustable scrollbar width, responsive mobile layouts, clearer codeblocks and themed callouts.

![RetroOS 98 screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thepharaohart/Obsidian-RetroOS98/HEAD/screen.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "RetroOS 98"
    author: "thepharaohart"
    repo:   "thepharaohart/Obsidian-RetroOS98"
    slug:   "retroos-98"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/retroos-98"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/thepharaohart/Obsidian-RetroOS98"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thepharaohart/Obsidian-RetroOS98/HEAD/screen.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Bring a faithful Windows 95/98 interface to Obsidian with retro UI elements, scrollbars, checkboxes, and file-explorer styling. Choose authentic Windows 95/98 color schemes including Windows Plus #4, switch light/dark modes, adjust scrollbar width, and use responsive mobile layouts with clearer codeblocks and themed callouts."
}
```
